Bad Dudes vs. Dragon Ninja (1989)(Data East)[cr Ikari][t +4 Ikari]
Bad Dudes vs. Dragon Ninja (1989)(Data East)[cr MHI][t +4 MHI]

games.name: Bad Enemies
games.overview: A beat-em up game for one or two players, simultaneous play.

games.name: Badge Bandit
games.overview: In this game, you play a police officer whose badge was stolen and hidden behind a wall. Blast through the wall and then shoot the badge.

games.name: BadLands
games.overview:
Badlands continued the Super Sprint lineage, but moved the game into a futuristic post-apocalyptic setting. The races consist of 3 souped-up cars toughing it out over 4 laps on one of the 8 tracks, which are viewed from above. Two human players can take part, but only the winner continues without using up credits, so you will only see the early races in two-player mode. 

You are armed with guns, which can be used to slow opposing cars. During the races spanners can be collected, which are then cashed in for upgraded turbos, improved weaponry and engine upgrades. Hazards on the later tracks include ramps, bridges, buildings collapsing onto the track and barriers which open and close in a random sequence.

games.name: Baffle
games.overview: Baffle is a puzzle game. The player's task is to recreate the arrangement of the numbers, letters or picture shown on the right. The board is 6x4 in size, with one empty window. An empty window is used to move a block one position. The time to solve the task is 3 minutes.

games.name: Bagdad
games.overview:
COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1984/11 (Issue #17), 64'er Spielesammlung #5, Super VIC & C64 A2-N01 (January 1985).  Beware of the evil genies determined to knock you from your magic carpet. With a little strategy and skill, you can trap them in bottles— but work quickly before they re-emerge. A lively arcade-style game. 

Flying through Bagdad on your magic carpet, you're suddenly accosted by some rug-riding evil genies bent on knocking you off — literally and 
figuratively. Your only defense is to knock them off first, and this takes some tricky maneuvering. First, you must trap each genie in a bottle. Then 
collect the bottles before the genies have a chance to escape. If you fail to collect a bottle in time, the lid opens and your battle resumes. 

The Calm Before The Storm

Ridding the city of enemy genies gives you a brief rest before the next wave of more numerous and determined genies. Only white genies are 
encountered during the first four waves, but the fifth wave brings a new, more aggressive menace — the blue genies. If you manage to reach the ninth wave, white, blue, and the dreaded purple genies emerge for a fast and furious battle. Twelve is the maximum number of genies that will appear, but the difficulty increases with each higher level. You begin with four green genies (one on the screen, three in reserve), and a new one is added for each 4000 points scored. For each bottle collected, 250 points are awarded.

games.name: Bagger
games.overview:
Bagger is a clone of the arcade classic Tapper. The main difference being that instead of Root Beer or beer, your character is a bag boy in a grocery store.

This game was developed by Kevin Black and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988/07 (Issue #61)

games.name: Bagitman
games.overview: Based on the arcade game Bagman, you are a robber, whose goal is to collect bags of money in each of the three scenes and dump them in your wheelbarrow, while avoiding miners and moving railcars. You can deal with the miners by using a pickaxe to knock them unconscious for a few seconds. If you are trying collect a money bag but a railcar gets in your way, you can cling onto the ceiling while it passes by. If you drop off the handholds on the ceiling at the right time, you can also ride the railcar to avoid the miners. Once you do collect all the bags of money in one scene, you simply move your wheelbarrow to the next scene. In fact, you can go between the 3 scenes at will; you do not have to collect all the money bags in one scene in order to proceed to the next. In the last two scenes, you have to use elevators to get from Point A to Point B. Be warned: you can only carry one money bag at a time, and the weight of the bag makes you move slowly, making it a lot easier for miners to catch you. Also remember that time is against you, but if you manage to dump a bag in the wheelbarrow, you are given more time. There is a special money bag (worth more points) inside a blocked off room, in the middle screen. You need the pickaxe to break through the wall to get it, but it is very heavy, and slows you down much more than a regular money bag.

games.name: Baji
games.overview: Baji is a German language strategical board game for 1-2 players. It was developed by Boris Kocjan and released into the public domain in 1986

games.name: Baker's Dozen
games.overview:
Baker's Dozen is a patience or card solitaire using a single pack of fifty-two playing cards. The game is so called because of the 13 columns in the game, the number in a baker's dozen.

This 1998 implantation of the game to the C64 was developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #172.

games.name: Balakon Raider
games.overview:
Several years have passed since the Earth was annexed to the Confederation and everything seemed to be going smoothly. But unfortunately, one day the alien barbarians infiltrated the land defense camp and took over the government residences of several provinces. You, aboard your super0equipped reconnaissance shuttle, have been instructed, as a modern sheriff, to chae these evil trainers through the corridors and floors of the buldings, destroying them all before moving on to the next building. But be very careful, because to stop your advance, some ghost aliens leave behind them dangerous mines, which will  obstruct your path and will destroy you if you touch them. You will need to disintegrate them if you want to pass further. 

Game published in Italy as Patrol in several Sipe publications such as Hit Parade C64 n.62 (Dicembre 1991), Hit Parade C64 n.15 (Settembre 1987) and I Magnifici 5 & 7 n.22 (marzo 1987).

games.name: Ball
games.overview:
The aim of this game is to steer a ball against the generic wall and fend it off if necessary. Sounds like the umpteenth variant of Breakout, but it is not.
In order not to let the player fall asleep, the program has a few nasty tricks in store. Another ball floats vertically up and down in the middle of the screen. If the cue ball touches the said ball, our peaceful cue ball becomes a mean contemporary whose sole aim is apparently to send the player onto the boards. Among other things, life can be deducted if the player's ball leaves the field, penalty points can be distributed, etc.
If the counter above the score display shows 3, the game is over (mostly for the player...) The only chance is to be faster and more skillful than the computer in order to stay afloat. With a little practice, you too can outsmart the computer.
A tip at the end: By pressing the fire button, the club can be moved faster - often very helpful for reaching the ball.

This pong\breakout style game was released as part of the Magic Disk 64 1990/02.

games.name: Ball-Blasta
games.overview: Ball-Blasta is a Breakout variant. The player controls a paddle which is stuck on the bottom of the screen and can only move left or right. It is used to bounce a a ball on the playfield - letting it pass causes the loss of a life. The goal is to clear the field of all destroyable blocks which is accomplished by hitting them with the ball. Harmful are aliens which fly around the screen. Every destroyed block lets money behind which falls down and has to be caught with the paddle. The money is used to buy extras between the 61 levels, e.g. a bigger paddle, a shield or three balls at once.

games.name: Ball Fighter
games.overview:
A SEUCK based shooter for 1 or 2 players, including simultaneous cooperative play. Released in Digital Marketing PD #092, released as Super Ball by Editions Fermont in Italy in Go Games n.43 (maggio 1989).  
 
With this beautiful arcade style game you can display your ability to control the Super Ball which you use to destroy the various asteroids and the many enemies that you will find along your path.

games.name: Ball-Job
games.overview: A logical puzzler that will keep you thinking and trying to stay one step ahead.

games.name: Ball-Land
games.overview: A pong\breakout style game with a twist, created by Freakout Productions and published by CP Verlag in 1993.

games.name: Ball-Land II
games.overview: Ball Land II is a updated Pong with a twist for Commodore 64, created by , published in 1994 by  Double Density.

games.name: Ball Maze
games.overview:
The most basic of games. Find your way out of the maze but with a gravity-like twist, from the book "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games", which was published in German as "Das Commodore 64 Spiele-Buch - 21 raffinierte Spiele", in Finnish as "Commodore 64 Ohjelmoinnin opas - Pelit", and in Italian as "Il Libro dei Giochi del Commodore 64,"

Steer the ball through the maze from beginning to end, without letting it drop into one of the holes. It needs a steady hand and quick reactions but given a little practice it can be done. Controls use Z, X, ; and /.

games.name: Ball Trap
games.overview: A crosshairs shooter created by Arnaud Hervas and published in Hebdogiciel N°146-149 (01.08.1986) where you must hit the skeet\trap shooting disks and the balloons. The speed and amount of items being thrown out increases as you qualify for the round and move on to the next one. At level 3 some of the ballloons come straight up from behind the mountains or travel quickly from top to bottom, making your shots much more difficult. Your crosshairs will loop from the top and bottom of the screen to the other side if that helps.

games.name: Ballblazer
games.overview:
In the year 3037, the most competitive sport in the known universe is Ballblazer. For the first time ever, humans from the planet Earth have won the right to compete in the final round of the Ballblazer Championship, to fight for Earth's honor and the title Masterblazer!

Ballblazer is a 3D futuristic soccer-like game, where the player (inside a Rotofoil) is set on a one-on-one 1,155 square playing field (the Grid). The objective of the player to kick a floating ball (Plasmorb) inside the opponent's goal (Goalbeams). A player may compete against a human or computer opponent.

The Rotofoil is equipped with a multi-purpose forcefield. This forcefield when in short distance of the Plasmorb will act as a pull field, automatically pulling the Plasmorb towards the player. When a player in possession of the Plasmorb shoots, the forcefield will act as push field and launches the ball. When the match starts, the player must move down field and attempt to gain possession of the Plasmorb using the joystick and blast the Plasmorb to an intended direction.

The player should also be aware that the Goldbeams move slightly every second and the distance between them will shrink. The highest scoring goals are goals made when Goldbeams have disappeared across the horizon (Over The Horizon/OTH shots). A player may also attempt to steal possession of a Plasmorb by rushing beside the opponent and blast the Plasmorb away. The game ends when time runs out or a player wins 10 consecutive goals. If the game ends in a draw, over-time will apply and the first player to score will win the game.

Scoring

    Close-in goals - 1 point
    Goals near Goldbeams - 2 points
    OTH shots - 3 points
    Players may steal points from each other by making goals.
    The total combined score of both players cannot accede more than 10 points.
    A player winning 10 consecutive points automatically wins the game.

games.name: Ballbooster
games.overview: Ballbooster is a shared-screen action/reflex video game for Commodore 64, created and published by Markt & Technik in 1988, it was published in both 64'er Sonderheft 30 and in 64'er Sonderheft 37. It is an action sports game for two opponents. A rousing mix of galactic sports game and real simulation: Ballbooster - great fun for two. With constantly new tactics and a lot of skill you outwit your fellow players.

games.name: Ballcrazy
games.overview: Erik the ball must bounce around the screen in this action game. The screens have several ledges, each of which changes colour when Erik touches it. The goal is to change them all to a specified colour, while avoiding the Chasers which try to stop him (despite the name, their movement paths are random). This must be done 4 times on each of the 8 levels, as a new layer of bricks are added above the old ones once they're finished. Several bonus items are around to make the task easier. - invincibility, extra lives, automatic layer completion, and bonus points.

games.name: Ballerup
games.overview:
More of a demo than a game but it boasts some nice music in this horizontally scrolling shooter you face wave on wave of ships and strange foes coming at you, with only your basic gun can you blast, avoid and survive?

Released in 1992 by DOME Development, programmed by Christian Schuh and tunes by Per Fredrik Kvarme & Arjan van der Werf.

games.name: Ballfever
games.overview:
So far, the c64 has largely been spared the dinosaur fever. Ball-Fever is now seizing the opportunity and is spreading at breakneck speed on all bread boxes in Germany. This game is an addiction! The gameplay is very simple.
You control a small ball that, thanks to its elastic properties, has the ability to develop enormous bounce from standing.
You have to guide the cute ball through numerous levels and protect it from all kinds of monsters. Slimy snails and jumping monsters have to be avoided.

The highlight of this game: It is played on two levels. For example, if you have bitten yourself above the surface of the earth, you can try to pave your way underground. Although the difficulty level is quite low at the beginning, you should be careful not to underestimate the game. It is all too easy to maneuver yourself into a hopeless situation.
 Have fun! Published in Magic Disk 64 1993/12.

games.name: Balliard
games.overview: A pong type game for 2 players only which developed by Thorsten Rüther & Marcus Arends and  released in 64'er Spielesammlung #1.

games.name: Ballmania
games.overview: In this simple Avoid-it style game by Amok Developments (represented by Oliver Malms, Doug Roberts, and  Thomas Mogensen) you try to dodge and weave and take your ball through this sector of space without touching any of the balls flying right at you! Published in Italy as Recrudew in both Super C64 e C128 n.52 (gennaio 1991) and Supplementi Edigamma/pubblirome - 100 games (1992).

games.name: Balloon Blitz
games.overview:
A very simple shooter game where you navigate the sky in a hot air balloon and drop bombs on enemy tanks down below. The  game was first published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1984/08 (Issue #14), and also in Courbois Software #6431. It was released in Australia and New Zealand as part of "Red Pack" compilation. Floating along in your hot-air balloon is a nice way to spend a beautiful summer morning. But you've got a mission; To destroy the enemy's tanks, which are threatening your force's flank. 
 

Alone in your anti-tank hot-air balloon, you're drifting along and enjoying the tranquility of a beautiful summer morning. And hoping the enemy stays out of sight — but you know they won't. They're sending their best tanks (which are wily and evasive) to get to your troop's southern flank, and your job is to destroy them. If you're skillful enough to stop the first wave, you're ready for the next game level. There are 6 difficulty levels with 6 as the most difficult.

games.name: Balloon Crazy (1985)
games.overview: A type-in game where you have to catch and balance balloons on your head. Pretty much a modified clone of Kickman. It was published in COMPUTE! 1985/12 (Issue #67) and COMPUTE!'s Third Book of C64 and was released as Wonderland by Caesar Software.

games.name: Balloon Crazy (1992)
games.overview: Balloon Crazy is a game designed by Ligia Latino for the Commodore 64 in 1992. It was published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1992/02-03. This is a game released in 1992, there is a game of the same name which was released in 1985, both from Compute! That game sort of borrowed elements of the arcade game Kickman. This one also borrows a lot from another arcade game, Anteater. The main difference is that instead of an anteater, you play a circus clown who needs to bust balloons with a hose that has a needle on it. However, in your way are monsters and magnets, and you have to avoid them as much as possible.  Another difference is that in Anteater, your character is on top of the screen, while in this game, your character is at the bottom.

games.name: Balloon Raid
games.overview:
Aim your AA gun to shoot down the balloons before they drop their dynamite on you. Watch out for other hazards like the birds and the helicopters. Published in Magic Disk 64 1988/03.
 
As a passionate fisherman, you have made it your mission to save the trout in your lake from the poisoning that threatens them from large boxes containing the chemical E605, which land on the lake with the help of gas balloons. So you grab your self-made 20 mm gun and use it to destroy the boxes floating down before they can reach the surface of the water. But beware! Don't overload the system

games.name: Balloon Rescue
games.overview: Balloon Rescue is a single screen game where you must move a hot-air balloon round a cavern collecting eight fuel cannisters before a clock reaches zero. Gravity plays a big part of the game and will pull your balloon downwards but you can move it left or right or give thrust to push it upwards. The cannisters are numbered and must be collected in the correct order and when you collect a cannister then you automatically go back to the centre of the cavern to get the next one. Once you collect all the cannisters then you move to the next cavern with stronger gravity and there is a third cavern afterwards which is classed as impossible. If you touch the walls of the cavern, hit a cannister at the wrong angle or run out of time then you lose one of there lives.

games.name: Balloonacy!
games.overview: Use the switch to open the exit then get your balloon to the exit without getting popped and before time runs out. Balloonacy is inspired by the arcade game Crazy Balloon, although it is not a direct port. Move your balloon to tough a switch to open the exit then make your way to the exit. Avoid force fields that go on and off and moving enemies. Do not tough the walls or the closed exit or you will pop. Do not dilly-dally as there is a time limit.

games.name: Balloonacy 2
games.overview: Released in GO64! 2005/11. Another crazy balloon adventure. Can you unlock all 16 caverns, packed with horrors and various obstacles? Get the key, unlock the door and flee through the exit. We know you can do it.

games.name: Ballooning
games.overview:
Ballooning is an educational simulation game where the player from the ages of 12 to 16 years old can learn to fly a hot air balloon safely over an ever-changing landscape with the use of the instrument panel.

The player can choose from different kinds of balloons and which of the three games they want to play. The first one is the Flying School where the player can learn how to fly a balloon with the controls.

The second one is the Flying Test where the player has to complete three tasks to prove the ability to fly a balloon. The last one is the Live Mission. The player will receive points with each task fulfilled. However, if the player fails to land on the landing place to get the task or fails to respond to the signals the player will lose points.

games.name: Bally
games.overview: A breakout clone game of "The Big 100" collection.

games.name: Ballyhoo
games.overview:
Ballyhoo is a mystery text adventure in which you play a disillusioned circus goer who decides to help find the owner's kidnapped daughter.

Gameplay involves searching for clues in the circus arena, the tents and other back areas trying to locate the girl. The game features a "Standard" difficulty level.

The original Commodore 64 Grey Box Contents included:
The Traveling Circus That Time Forgot Inc. Official Souvenir Program
Circus Ticket (Sec.24 Row AA Seat 4)
Purple Circus Balloon
Advertising Card for Dr. Nostrum's Wondrous Curative

games.name: Banana Dash
games.overview: Published in GO64! 2004/08. Guide Splidge around the arena, collecting bananas but watch out for the boulders otherwise you will become flat as a pancake. Best of luck to you.

games.name: Banana Drama
games.overview:
The last President of Ananaba has been overthrown, and you have now become President of the small state, and you now have to attempt to govern for as long as possible while trying to keep everyone happy while trying to stay alive. Banana Drama is a strategy game where you are presented with various options and choices to make as you make your decisions on a monthly basis. The first screen gives you the choice of seeing a status report, which costs you if you want to see it. This shows Power and Support given by various people and departments in the State like plantation owners, Armed Forces, workers and Trade Unions, as well as the countries the Soviet Union and America.

After looking at your finances you then receive requests from the people and departments like sacking someone, receiving more money or putting someone in power. Once you make your choices you now have your Presidential options where you can look after your status by giving yourself more money, buying a submarine, increasing your protection and other things for your benefit. Each option leads to another menu where you can make further decisions to either become a dictator or help your people by giving them more money and a better way of life. The Soviet Union and America will also decide how they want to help you by your decision-making, and you can go to them asking for more money. If your support and power decreases enough, then you can be overthrown and even executed.

games.name: Banana Jones and the Temple of Goons
games.overview: You are the brave, yet slightly overweight adventurer Melvin "Banana" Jones. Armed with only a whip, You are on a mission in South America and you have to stop the Nazis from taking over South America's banana crops.

versions.label: Banana Jones and the Temple of Goons (1989)(Binary Zone)(PD)[cr TBT]

games.name: Bandana City
games.overview:
As the good sheriff of Bandana County, your job is to collect enough gold so that you can marry the mayor's daughter. Stopping you from doing this are a wide range of enemies, such as hamburgers, video nasties, gophers, giant spiders, the Sitting Bull Bikers, telephones, monitors and more. Each day is split into two sections. The first section has you basically avoiding enemies while collecting money bags, which come in both blue and pink. The blue money bags you have to get, and the pink ones you have to avoid. If you try to get a pink one, then you will lose a life.

The second section involves you riding a horse across the screen, while shooting enemies that get in your way. If a bullet comes in contact with an enemy, then it is stunned and returned to its starting position. If you come into contact with an enemy or touch a fence, you will lose one of your lives. Lose all of them and you are doomed to spend the rest of your days on Boot Hill.

games.name: Bandit
games.overview:
Bandit is a 1 player gambling game for multiple systems.

Contains 2 slot machines: Kings Ransom and Silver Knight. The player starts with $9 - $200. The player can feed up to $3 into the Kings Ransom machine, and can only win on a single line. Silver Knight allows the player to feed up to $5 into the machine, and the player can win on 5 separate lines. The player must individually feed in coins and pull the handle on the machine. The game is over when all money is used up.

games.name: Bandits
games.overview:
Your job is to guard the supplies at the lunar base. Bandits of various sorts arrive in waves and descend, trying to get the goods. Armed with a mobile laser gun and some shielding, you score points by blasting the bandits.

Bandits has 28 levels of play. You begin with 5 ships and acquire a bonus ship for every 5,000 points. The game is similar to Space Invaders.

games.name: Banger Racer
games.overview: Banger Racer is a management game where you manage the career of a young up and coming banger car driver as he goes from Division 3 all the way up to Division 1 and become champion. You are presented with various options which helps you make him a better driver and keep him in a serviceable car while making money. You can send your driver on training courses, buy a better car, maintain his car and get sponsors, as well as keeping an eye on the bank statement. Once you enter a race for a fee you then watch the race as your driver attempts to win or finish the best he can over various laps viewed from above. Once the race is over you are told the health of your driver as he can be injured and miss races over a number of weeks, and if the car is damaged enough then this can be out of action for a number of weeks as well. Drivers receive points for the position they finish and the idea is to finish a season to get promotion to the next division or to be champion.

games.name: Bangers & Mash
games.overview: Bangers & Mash is a game based on the British kids TV show of the same name and sees you play as Bangers as you try to help your Mother by collecting fruit for a pie. The game is a platform game and over various levels you must traverse platforms while avoiding or shooting the various creatures. If you touch a creature, certain coloured flowers or obstacles then you lose one of three lives. There are three types of fruit to collect with the number to collect below the main playing area and once all are collected you move to the next level.

games.name: Bangkok Knights
games.overview:
From the humble peasant farmers of Thailand came one of the world's most devastating forms of combat, Thai Boxing - the fastest, meanest and most exciting full contact sport in the world of martial arts. 

In this unique simulation of Muay Thai (Thai Boxing) you must fight your way from the cliff ledge above your village, through the jungle and into the streets of Bangkok. Only after defeating all the street-wise opponents will you be granted the right to fight in the famous Lumpini stadium, here you will encounter the greatest exponents of the sport, the Bangkok Knights.

games.name: Bank Raid
games.overview:
Bankersville was a quiet town until each of its banks received a thousand bars of gold and the crime media found out. Now, the town is full of robbers, who in turn are robbing each of the banks. You have been employed by the town to shoot the robbers at each bank as they appear at the bank's windows in its vaults. However, you only have the time it takes them to put 10 gold bars into their bags. If you do not shoot them by then, they empty the gold into their truck at the rear of the bank and come back for more. If they steal all 1000 gold bars from the bank, they make off with the gold and you're fired. If you shoot the robbers before tehy steal all the gold  you will get a reward. The amount depends on how much the lorry driver did not get away with. 
Published in Commodore User 1985/01 (Games Extra Book).

games.name: Bankrupt
games.overview: Bankrupt is a board game for 2-4 players (there is no computer AI). It is heavily inspired by Monopoly. It was developed by Ken Smith and published by Argus Press Software in 64 Tape Computing No. 12 (1985/10).

games.name: Bannercatch
games.overview: Bannercatch is an educational action game for two players. The game is a variation of capture the flag; two human players compete against Max and his team of robots. To win the game, the players need to work as a team to travel to Max's zone of the playfield, capture the flag, and bring it back safely back before Max is able to capture the players flag. Each time the players successfully capture one of Max's flags, part of his face will be revealed; the goal is to try to see all of Max's face. To help with this quest, the game includes maps which provide an overview of the entire playing field (each player will only be able to see a small portion on the screen at a time). Also, hints about his flags whereabouts can be gained by tricking Max into telling about it. This is done by positioning a player over one of the robot sensors and attempting to communicate with Max disguised as one of his robots. Since Max talks to his robots in binary, the player will need to translate a series of binary numbers to convince Max to reveal clues about his flags location. At any time during the game the player can freeze the action; this allows for checking the maps or taking a rest. The game features five different levels of difficulty along with a demonstration mode. Points are earned for successfully capturing the flag, tagging a robot which is carrying your flag, and winning the game.

games.name: Banshee Castle
games.overview:
Marry the Princess and get out of Banshee Castle alive - if you can! 
 
The player has been captured by banshees within a castle. The player must find and free the princess hidden within the castle, and escape to safety. The player has limited health, and can be injured by banshee attacks and roaming jesters. A wandering monk can heal the player. The player must gather items and solve inventory puzzles. All commands are via VERB NOUN entry. There is a save/restore feature.

games.name: Baphomet
games.overview:
A SEUCK game by Anthony Burns in conjunction with The New Dimension for one or two players, with cooperative play available. NOTE: This game contains nudity and situations that some may found offensive. This is to some degree a one-player game, but it uses both joysticks, so two player is naturally easier. You start the game on foot, using joystick port two (If you try to start using port one, you will not be able to progress beyond the opening screen). If you can get past level 2, you will be instructed to switch to port one. From this point on, you will be flying, and the game will scroll automatically.

When you are told to “stand by” do not move the joystick, or you risk colliding with dangerous areas of the background. These have been placed in such a way as to make certain levels inaccessible to the “walker” and others to the “flyer” so that they can only be on-screen at the correct time.

When you are on-foot, you fight at close range, in the direction you are pointing. Do not venture off the grey walkways: the infrastructure of the conversion centre is deadly to the touch, and keep clear of the walkway edges where the passage is narrow. Similar caution applies when you are flying: steer clear of anything that is not plain sky (unless it is a bonus pickup). When you are flying, you fire forwards, with a long-range weapon.

games.name: Barbarian (Psygnosis)
games.overview: In this game you play the role of a barbarian who must navigate his way through dangerous dungeons. The game is played from a third person side scrolling perspective and also has platform jumping parts to it. The barbarian is controlled by using left and right on the joystick to move and up and down is used to scroll through the various commands at the bottom of the screen. When a command is highlighted pressing fire will perform that action thus saving on extra buttons being needed to play. There are two weapons at your disposal. A sword which you start the game with and later a bow which is handy for long range attacks. There are many traps to avoid and various monsters who have different attack patterns.

games.name: Barbie
games.overview: Barbie gets a phone call from her boyfriend Ken, asking her if she wants to go somewhere with him. Where Ken says depends on the current game being played, and can include going to the prom, going out to dinner, going to the pool, playing tennis, working out at the gym, or having a picnic. You control Barbie, and your job is to get her ready by going shopping and selecting dresses, swimwear, shoes, hairstyle, and other outfits. This can be done by stopping her car in front of a store and going in. You use the joystick to move the "hand" over the various items in the store. You can also select its color and pattern. Clicking on these will cause Barbie to wear it. If you change you mind, you can change into something else. When you wear something you do not need, there is no way that you can remove it. One of these might not be relevant to the situation, so common sense should tell you what you really need. Once you are done with all of this, you travel back to Barbie's house where you can find out if you have the right outfit. If you did, then you are shown a picture of Barbie and Ken having a good time. Otherwise, you are faced with the next situation.

games.name: Barmy Bill's Flight of Fun
games.overview: A Horizontally scrolling shooter created by Lee Hudson & David Green and presented by Break Point.

versions.label: Barmy Bill's Flight of Fun(Lee Hudson & d Green)[cr Nato]
Barmy Bill's Flight of Fun(Lee Hudson & d Green)[cr DCS]
Barmy Bill's Flight of Fun(Lee Hudson & d Green)[cr SCS]
Barmy Bill's Flight of Fun(Lee Hudson & d Green)[cr Oase]
Barmy Bills Flight of Fun(Lee Hudson & d Green)[cr DOM][t +1 DOM]

games.name: Barmy Builders
games.overview:
Frank the Foreman collects falling pound notes to pay his workers to build a new house. His arch rival Evil Eric is after him. Avoid the Eric, dodge the darts and grab the cash that will allow you to build your house. Use the balloons to quickly get to the top of the platform quickly and slide quickly down to escape the threats that come after you. 
 
Was released as Brick Layer in Italy's Peek n.11 (novembre 1985).

games.name: Barney Brown and the Chicago Connection
games.overview: Help a friend in the MI5 by bringing a secret file to Chicago in this text adventure from Mandy Rodrigues, released by Atlas Adventure Software in 1987.

versions.label: Barney Brown and the Chicago Connection (1987)(Atlas Adventure Software)[cr TCS]

games.name: Baron: The Real Estate Simulation
games.overview: As with Blue Chip's other business simulation games, the objective in Baron is to get filthy rich by speculating and trading - this time around, in the American real estate market. The game is turn-based: each turn represents one month of market activities, and allows you to eyeball the market trends, get the lowdown on various properties, buy/sell them, trade in options and and take out loans. You start out with $35,000 in cash and the status of Novice, which carries some limitations like lower loans and high closing costs on sales. As you increase your net worth, becoming an Investor or a Banker, the limitations relax and you gain better leverage. The goal is to achieve the status of Baron by piling up a net worth of $1,000,000 within 60 months, but if you pull that off, you may still opt to go for the next million and see how quick you can get there. On the other hand, a lack of business savvy may leave you bankrupt. Up to 14 players may record their status and history, although only one can play at a time. A single game session may be saved to disk and resumed later.

versions.label: Baron The Real Estate Simulation (1983)(Blue Chip Software)

games.name: Barrel Jump
games.overview: A game of the notorious "Cassette 50" collection. In this game, you're Brewery Bill, a delivery man for the local microbrewery. First cross on the moving barrel to the other side. Then climb up the ladder until you reach the level with the flashing barrel. Pick up the barrel and take it back to the lorry for delivery. You have picked up a barrel when the beed stops and the barrel stops flashing. If you fall off the ladder or miss the barrel or your tip runs out then you are fired and instantly killed.

games.name: Barrier System
games.overview:
Barrier System is a unique twist on the classic Breakout/Arkanoid formula. Instead of clearing all bricks, your goal is to break through the barrier at the top of the screen by removing at least one brick from the top row. This strategic shift adds a new layer of depth, requiring precision rather than total destruction.

Unlike traditional paddle mechanics, the bat in Barrier System is fully maneuverable both horizontally and vertically, giving players more control over their shots and positioning. However, an added challenge comes in the form of roaming enemies, such as UFOs, which move across the screen. Colliding with these hazards costs the player a life, adding an element of danger beyond just keeping the ball in play.

With its innovative mechanics and arcade-style gameplay, Barrier System offers a fresh challenge for fans of brick-breaking games.

games.name: Bart Simpson
games.overview: Move Bart and jump to your trusted skateboard.

games.name: Baseball
games.overview: Baseball game released as part of the part of "Sports Spectacular" game pack.

games.name: Baseline
games.overview:
A spaceship is on a mission: it flies over enemy bases and is subjected to fire from the base and must avoid flying objects, for impact with them can destroy your craft. The action begins in a path limited by two walls which must not be touched. you will need to be a master pilot to avoid the walls, enemy fire and craft. You have three lives to get you to the end of the challenge. 

Published in Italy as Moonbase in Logica 2000 n.90 (1989).

games.name: Basil the Great Mouse Detective
games.overview: Based on the 1986 Walt Disney animated movie, the story revolves around a mouse named Basil who lives in the basement of the famous Sherlock Holmes residence 221B Baker Street. Basil's friend Dr. Dawson has been kidnapped by the villainous Professor Ratigan and he must search through London for clues that will lead him to the fiend's lair. The game is a colorful platform adventure through 3 locales: London's shops and docks, the sewers and finally the den of Ratigan. In each area, 5 clues must be found by exploring objects such bags and sacks, cans, jars and chests found in each screen with Basil's magnifying glass. He must pick up clues to fill 5 pockets in his coat and then he will be able to determine if some are fake (as Ratigan has scattered 8 fake clues among each locale). Fake ones must be dropped until all 5 real clues are found then you get a clue to the level exit to go to the next locale. If you can't find the exit, each clue can give a hint as to what direction you should go in. Your energy runs down as you go through the multi-level platform screens and encounter Rattigan's goons but some objects will contain cheese which restores energy or mousetraps which when laid in path of the goons will make them harmless (though they take up a pocket until used).

Basil The Great Mouse Detective (1987)(Gremlin Graphics)[cr ACE]
