If Dicky is touched by Stephen or the web is destroyed without collecting the diamond then he loses one of three lives and the web has to be completed again if a life is lost. Before the game starts there are a number of options that can be changed and these include the before mentioned limited or unlimited flights, starting level (1-7), game speed (0-9), and if a 2nd spider called Cecil appears after level 7. The joystick or keyboard is used to control Dicky and the high scores can be saved.

games.name: Dictator
games.overview:
You are the dictator of the fictional republic of Ritimba. Your task is to keep everybody happy - the army, the peasants, the land owners.... while secretly filling your personal bank account as much as possible. You've got the secret police on your side... and the guerrillas on the other one. Every month, one of those groups makes a request. You can accept it (which might involve quite a bit of money) or deny it, making groups either happy or not. You can also choose to borrow money from the Russians or the Americans.
As the old saying goes.. it's impossible to make everybody happy. So sooner or later, you'll be facing a revolution or assassination attempt. Did you purchase that helicopter or are you going to face the music?

games.name: Die Alien Slime
games.overview: Die Alien Slime is a simple shooter with top-down perspective, like Alien Syndrome. The player controls a lone spaceman, who must fight against aliens and activate special terminals. Many of these terminals can be found scattered around the ship. In the space base there are many barriers: doors, transport blocks and energy barriers. The space base is a labyrinth, colonized by hundreds of aliens.

versions.label: Die! Alien Slime (1989)(Mastertronic)[cr TAL+INC][f NTSC][t +2 TAL]

games.name: DIE: Death in Effect
games.overview: An arcade collect'em up game by Torbjörn Härje.

versions.label: DIE Death in Effect (1989)(Bratpack)[cr Triad][t +4 Triad]

games.name: Die Dunkle Dimension
games.overview: Dunkle is a German Ultima IV clone, and unlike the author of most clones, the developer here did a good job retaining most of what makes Ultima IV so special, including the keyword-based dialogue system, the sense of exploring a large world, and the tactical combat screen. It lacks the virtue system, of course, and you control only one party member throughout the game. Still, it's a better clone than most and all in German.

games.name: Die Flucht der Sumpfgeister
games.overview: When the people began to drain the swamp, the swamp spirits made their escape to a unknown world  with the only available magic vacuum cleaner, but a swamp spirit has swallowed up the departure and must be dealt with. Also published in Power-Games (Bestell-Nr. 38785).

versions.label: Wuckel Die Flucht der Sumpfgeister (1988)(Markt & Technik)(de)

games.name: Die Hard 2: Die Harder
games.overview:
Die Hard 2: Die Harder is a 2D shooting gallery.
In the early 90’s, two things just wouldn’t die: Bruce Willis in the Die Hard trilogy of movies, and, well, 2D point-and-click shooters. Renowned software undertaker Grandslam was happily ready to dig the grave several inches deeper for both. The spade: a game called Die Hard 2: Die Harder.
Based on the 1990 movie Die Hard 2, the program sends you through five stages modeled after key scenes of the film. As N.Y. cop John McClane, you have to shoot terrorists invading Washington’s Dulles airport by quickly aiming a crosshair at them. You’ll successively clear the luggage center, airport annex and runway, then chase after the bad guys on a snowmobile and finally shoot it out on the wing of the terrorist’s plane. Each stage consists of three screens; on the last one, several tougher bosses will appear. Occasionally, civilians cross the room and pray that you don’t kill them. Most dying terrorists drop power-ups, namely med-kits, armour, grenades and weapons that are more powerful or fire faster. You collect these items by shooting them in time. If you do not aim fast enough, the terrorist’s bullets will drain your health; you may die three times, but after that, John McClane bites the dust once and for all. Until you restart, that is. For more information on the movie Die Hard 2, see the trivia and links sections.

versions.label: Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr NEI Legend][t +3 NEI]
Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr M8Q][t +8 M8Q]
Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr Triangle][t +5 Triangle]
Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr M8][t +8 M8]
Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr X R][t +4 X R]
Die Hard 2 Die Harder (1991)(Grandslam Entertainment)[cr UCS][t +6 UCS]

games.name: Die Hard (Activision)
games.overview:
There are 40 terrorists scattered throughout the building, and John McClane's task is to clear each floor of terrorists, and he can then use the stairwell or the express elevator to travel upwards, to a maximum of floors 31-35 (more floors are unlocked in "Advanced" mode). In addition, by shooting at grids in the wall, John is able to climb in the vents, dropping into a designated spot or moving down or up a floor.

At the start of the game, the player character can only use a pistol (with 15 bullets) and his fists to dispose of enemies, but later acquires several weapons, such as submachine guns, explosives and flashbangs which the terrorists can also use. When McClane is shot, a few picked up items can drop where he must pick them up again. The player's bullets have minimal range, and due to the control scheme can only be aimed at 90 or 45 degree angles. However once acquired, the submachine gun can also fire a spray of bullets in an arc, allowing for more firing angles. McClane's health, which is drained by bullet wounds, can be restored by collecting soda cans from either enemies, snack machines (by shooting several bullets at them) or empty rooms. The player loses the game when all life is lost.

The player has about four minutes before one of the six locks are opened, but can gain more time by destroying the main computer on the fourth floor. Once all the locks have been opened, the vault is opened and the game's final battle is triggered. The player has only a few minutes to go to the 30th floor, for a final confrontation with Karl, Hans, and any of the 40 terrorists left alive.

One interesting aspect of the game allows the player to listen to Hans shouting orders to his guards through a two-way radio. However, after the second lock is opened, Hans will tell everyone to not use the radio. Also notable is the "foot meter". The meter starts out full, but will eventually decrease if the player character steps on shattered glass or runs around. If the meter becomes empty, McClane will walk much slower than he does when the foot meter is full. It can be restored by collecting med-kits.

The game features cinematic sequences, which change the story depending on which actions the player takes. For example, if there is fewer than one minute left, and the player defeats Karl, the last scene with John and Holly will tell the player the roof has been destroyed by the helicopter sent by Hans.

games.name: Die Hard (CP Verlag)
games.overview:
This one isn't a Christmas game, this is the *other* version, a tank duel game created by Andre Ducree and published in Magic Disk 64 1990/08. Just one thing about the game: dismantle the enemy tank before it dismantles you!
You steer the bowl as usual, only this time the fire button has two meanings: A short press gives the enemy the grenade, while a long press the driver jumps into the fresh air for a round, for example. B. from the gas station at the bottom of the screen to cart a spare canister of gasoline. As soon as the hubby's corner flashes, the canister is bunkered and it's home. The ammunition supply works in exactly the same way.
At the top of the screen is another workshop where you can bring your heart back into shape. Just drive on it and the damage level will drop.
Of course "DIE HARD" is a baller orgy for two Freds. Fred 1 with the joystick in port # 2 rolls the green tank from the left, Fred 2 in port # 1 with the red one from the right. The indications available to each maniac are SCORE, FUEL, AMMO. and DAMAGE and hardly need to be explained in more detail.
So, since after the games described above, saliva drips out of the mouth of every real shooting maniac with joy, that's the end of it

games.name: Die Insel
games.overview: It is the year 2049. An anonymous demand is relayed to the world's media stations making huge demands on the population of the United States and the Soviet Union, If his demands are not met, he will destroy the earth. All the intelligence agencies in the world were trying to locate the place from which the message had been sent. A German team of researchers succeeded shortly before the end of the ultimatum to learn the approximate location of the terrorist. However, it was thought to be too late to intervene in his plans. However, at the last second, fourteen people managed to leave Earth with an ancient spaceship before the explosive end. Due to the tremendous pressure, the spaceship was thrown out into a time-space vortex and landed in another time time. Professor Schmidt, a German teacher, was selected to travel back to the year 2049 to find the unknown offender, to prevent him from carrying out his evil deed. You are now taking on the role of Professor Schmidt. Try to find the victim's lair and prevent the worst from happening.

games.name: Die Pyramide
games.overview: A highly recommended platforming game created by Hans J. Baer and published in Magic Disk 64 1989/08. The game can be quite frustrating as there are lots of different paths to take and only one exit. Also unlike other games the enemies are totally random in their movements.

games.name: Die Versunkene Stadt
games.overview:
An action game created by John Bettels and released in Input 64 1986/06. You are in a spaceship with limited energy and oxygen supplies and, after you have picked up at least seven diamonds, you are supposed to find the sunken city. So far so good. Of course, the author has built in some difficulties, but also the possibility to fill up on both energy and oxygen on the way, or simply to be transported from here to there. Keep fueled up and refill your oxygen supply by touching the flashing oxygen tanks. Some locks release themselves at certain intervals, while others have a door opener in front of and behind the lock. If you want to be transported to another section of the game without stress, you should (as always from above) drive onto the large box. If you're unlucky, you'll come out in the same place. 

If you have collected enough diamonds and nothing has fallen on your head along the way, you can remove the last barrier with the fire key (space bar) when you reach the city (it must be somewhere). The game ends when you drive towards a house. We wish you a steady hand (some passages are really narrow) and a lot of fun on the journey of discovery.

games.name: Diffuser
games.overview: Diffuser is a a game in which the goal is to diffuse bombs set by terrorists. It was developed by Mike Fleischner and released into the public domain. The year of release is currently unknown.

games.name: Dig Dug
games.overview: The objective of Dig Dug is to eliminate underground-dwelling monsters. This can be done by inflating them until they pop or by dropping rocks on them. There are two kinds of enemies in the game: Pookas, round red monsters (said to be modeled after tomatoes) who wear yellow goggles, and Fygars, green dragons who can breathe fire. The player's character is Dig Dug, dressed in white and blue, and able to dig tunnels. Dig Dug is killed if he is caught by either Pooka or Fygar, burned by a Fygar's fire, or crushed by a rock.

games.name: Dig Dug Revival
games.overview: This game is a homage to Dig Dug, an arcade game developed by Namco in 1982.

games.name: Digger (Compute! Publications)
games.overview: COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1985/03 (Issue #21), and in Super VIC & C64 A2-N08 (September 1985). This game may not be the Greatest of all Time, but it does contain a bunch of GOATs! The object of Digger is to avoid three billy goats who are gruffly pursuing you through underground terrain. You can make the goats vanish by digging the soil from under any of 3 rocks in time to fall on the heads of as many goats are in the way. You can also immobilize them momentarily by inflating them with your trusty air pump. (Hold on, this is starting to sound familiar.) Remember you cannot disengage until you've hit F7 long enough to fully inflate the nanny. Meanwhile, other goats continue to hunt you down. Like they do.

games.name: Digger (Richard Caravella)
games.overview: A basic action game developed by Richard Caravella and published in UpTime Vol.1 #03.

games.name: Diggits
games.overview: A Brain\Puzzle game created by Dome Development and published by Markt & Technik.

games.name: Digit Fidget
games.overview: Digit Fidget is a mathematical puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed in 1990 by Penny DeGroff and published in Loadstar #076.

games.name: Digital Tangram
games.overview: A logic\brain game that was created by Thomas Verbeek & Hans-Joachim Nolte and published in Game On 1990/11.

games.name: Digithunt
games.overview: Digithunt is the first home computer implementation of the game Sudoku. It is a number-puzzle game where you have to place missing numbers in the gaps, in such a way that each column, each row, and each 3x3 boxes contains all of the digits from 1 to 9. There are 9 skill levels, 1 easiest and 9 the hardest. On the easiest skill level there are fewer gaps with missing digits, on skill level 9 there are many gaps with missing digits. The score board contains a high score per skill level. Published in Loadstar #060.

games.name: Dimension-X
games.overview: Dimension-X is a action, avoid it type game, although it looks like it was initially set to be a shooter. It was released in 1998 by Ninja Soft and was programmed by Laze Ristoski with music by Adam Gilmore.

games.name: Dinky Doo
games.overview: Dinky Doo is a single screen game viewed from above where you are in a nightmare due to a cheese sandwich you had eaten before bed, even though your Mother said not to. The only way out of this bad dream is to complete various levels to reach the safety of your Mother's room by collecting your hot milk on each screen. Each screen has walls and various creatures that move around the screen and if you touch the walls or a creature then you lose one of three lives. If you reach your hot milk then some of the creatures turn to cherries and these can be collected as you head towards a door that has appeared. On later levels there are lasers that turn on and off and are deadly to the touch. An oxygen bar decreases and fills up when you collect the milk and starts decreasing again as you go to the door, and this just gives you bonus points when the level is completed.

games.name: Dino Eggs
games.overview: While on an expedition through time to the prehistoric past, Time Master Tim accidentally brings a case of European Measles to that era. He has to return the Dino eggs to the present time in order to save them from this epidemic. Tim has to face the dino egg predators, such as spiders and snakes which will contaminate the eggs. The mother of the eggs also lurks by, and if a fire is not built, she may just step in. Will you be able to save the dinosaur race from extinction?

games.name: Dino Wars
games.overview: Dino Wars is a strategic board game with some similarities to chess, with combat decided by action scenes. If you ever played Archon you know the idea behind this game. On a chess-like board (9x10 pieces in this game) you move different sorts of dinosaurs. If you hit an square on which an opponent dinosaur stands, the game changes to action mode. This is played as a beat-'em-up, in which you must beat the opponent dinosaur to win the square. Each dinosaur has it's own strategies, movement restrictions and different combat skills - which are roughly based on the historical properties of the real dinosaurs. As a result, knowing which dinosaurs are likely to win combat is crucial to the strategy. The action scenes can be played independently of the main strategic game.

games.name: Dinorace 64
games.overview: A dinosaur racing game by Frank Abbing and published in Game On 1990/03. Hello and welcome to the 4th Intergalactic Saurian races on the battle asteroid Delagod. Turn on your TVs and experience the stampede. If you are fast you will be the champion of the year 2127.

games.name: Dinox
games.overview:
Published in November 1993 by Art Project Studios (APS), Musicians: Jeroen Tel, Macmagix & Karl Sommer, Graphicians: Rainer Böhme & Daniel Löwe
Programmer: Rainer Böhme, this platformer challenges your reptilian alter ego to find the keys and make your way to the level's exit. You will need to overcome challenges and fiendish traps to do so.

games.name: Dioroid
games.overview:
Diorid is a puzzle solving game. The main goal requires removing all the blocks from the board within limited time. By clicking on a single spot, the player affects central field (selected one) and all the fields placed directly diagonally next to the central block by their reversal - filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 5 fields, one in the middle, and 4 around.

The game features 99 levels.

games.name: Dip Diver
games.overview: Released in Your Commodore 1991/06 (Tape #18). An excellent undersea wobbler of a game. Set deep beneath the sea, you play a diver who has stumbled across a load of treasure and you want to make off with it pretty quickly. At least, before anyone else comes along. You have to negotiate the tortuous rock passageways and collect all the flashing treasure objects. Unfortunately, there are lots of hostile creatures trundling around these caverns and they're not too nice to touch.  They won't go for your throat but you'l die if you touch them. No sea monsters were harmed in the playing of this game, so you'll have to use your skill and wits to avoid them and the rock walls that will rip your suit open. Do all this while watching your air supply so you can top up at Air Rooms dotted about the place. Dive in and let rip!

games.name: Diplomat
games.overview: A two-deck solitaire game from Maurice Jones, the acknowledged master of solitaire card game simulations published in Loadstar #184 in 1999.

games.name: Diplomat's Dilemma
games.overview: You're an important diplomat who has been kidnapped. You've decided to make an attempt to escape but not without your briefcase and evidence against the terrorists.

games.name: Dippy Dappy
games.overview: Published in the book "Winning Games on the Commodore 64" and the German version, "Das große Commodore-64-Spiele-Buch". "You chuck the apples on over, Dappy, and I'll catch them", you say. But Dappy isn't too bright and can't tell the difference between the apples you want and those eggs the fowl left in the orchard. If you don't want a face full of yolk, you'd better catch them all!

games.name: Direct Hit
games.overview: Crosshairs skeet shooting. Choose either the shotgun, rifle, or pistol to hit 20 or 30, the game by Tommi Tenhula was published in Floppy Magazine 1988/1, a disk-only magazine. Each type of firearm has a different type of cross-hairs and different performance.

games.name: Di's Baby
games.overview:
After giving birth to Prince William, Prince Charles and Princess Diana of the British Royal Family have decided that they want another baby. Di's Baby is a collection of five games, from being tested at being a good parent to giving birth to the baby, each game has to be completed to move to the next one. There are no lives but a AF counter and every time you are hit by an object or touch one then this increases and when it reaches 1000 then it is game over. The five games are:
The Joys of Parenthood: Based on the arcade game Space Invaders, this game is a single screen side view shooter where you control the head and arm of Prince Charles at the bottom of the screen, moving left or right carrying a potty. Above Charles are four rows of potties moving across the screen and moving down one place when they reach the side of the screen. All the potties have to be removed by firing toilet rolls upwards at them while catching falling poo from Prince William in the potty he is carrying for extra points. A large toilet roll occasionally makes an appearance and has to be shot.
The Conception: A single screen platformer where Charles has to get from the top left of the screen down to the bottom left of the screen to Diana's bed so he can conceive the baby. As you make your way down the screen there are obstacles like a pram, guard and a camera that have to be avoided.
The Long Wait: Diana is now pregnant but she has to avoid all the paparazzi chasing her for nine months in this single screen shooter where you have to reach a number representing each month. As you go to the number you have to avoid or shoot many cameras and when you reach the number it changes to a new number in a new position.
The Dash to the Hospital: A top view scrolling driving game where the screen scrolls when you move the car and you have to get Diana to the hospital. As you drive through the streets you have to avoid a steering wheel as well as police barriers, striking miners and CND rallies.
The Delivery: Now in the hospital, Diana has to give birth in this single platformer where you have to get Diana from the bottom of the screen to the top climbing ladders. As you try to get up the screen, a large epidural needle moves around and must be avoided. Once you reach the top, a stork will drop your baby and you have to catch it.

games.name: Disaster Flight
games.overview:
A single player flight simulator game from Tim Hartnell & Brett Hale and published in 1984 in the book, "The Big Fat Book of Commodore 64 Games". 
 
Here's your chance to fly a plane, with a complex and fairly realistic flight simulator program. Russia has planted a nuclear device somewhere in_ the United States. The. president has called an emergency meeting with the country's top five nuclear physicists. You are the president's private pilot, and you've been assigned to find, pick up and deliver the five scientists to New York, where the president is waiting. However, to do this you have to cover every inch of the country in order to find them. 


If you decide to fly below 1000 feet, then you run the risk of hitting a mountain. You are able to go around, or over a mountain, but if you take too long to decide what to do, you'll fly straight into it. As you fly around the country, you'll see the current State that you're over is shown in the top Left hand corner of the screen in purple. If you pass over a State which contains a scientist, then the name of the State will be shown in white. Each State is shown as one or more five by five squares. As some States are’ Larger than others, you'll see these represented by two or more of the groups of squares.  
 
Set you elevator, plan your airspeed, hand on the throttle, check your compass, foot off the brakes, take off and get into the air!

games.name: DISC: Damned into Space-Craft
games.overview: A great looking vertical shoot 'em up by COSMOS DESIGNS and is the 1st game they produced. Keep your fire button pressed when you want to use any of the pickups. This game was published in Magic Disk 64 1991/02, in Game On GE 1992/2, and in Abo Disk #3. In this shooter the player has to fly a space craft through four levels fighting off various enemy formations. Enemies differ in speed and size and follow different attack patterns. Colliding with enemies or a projectiles decreases the space crafts energy. Items that replenish energy can be collected as well as shields that decrease the amount of damage taken from collisions. Other items include smart bombs, a more powerful shot and a side-laser. At the end of each level, a boss has to be defeated.

DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr Warning]
DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr O]
DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr Fact]
DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr Dominators]
DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr Collision]
DISC Damned into Space Craft (1991)(Magic Disk)[cr Hitmen]

games.name: Disc-O-Very
games.overview: A logic\brain puzzle game created by Antoine van Wel and published in Game On 1993/11.

versions.label: Disc O Very (1993)(CP Verlag)[cr VDV][t +3 VDV]

games.name: Discovery
games.overview: It is the future and a long missing space station, the Discovery, has been found. Unfortunately the defense systems have been activated and need to be shut down before the station can be used again. Not entirely surprisingly, the player is responsible for this mission. Discovery is a mini game collection with a main game wrapped around. Said game is a straight top-down shooter in which the player flies over the space station while shooting at and avoiding the defense robots. Being hit results in energy loss and zero energy results in death. The station has twelve hatches, each with a mini game behind it, which need to be entered to assemble the circuit board needed to shut down the defenses. Every solved mini game restores the player's energy. The mini games itself are mostly variants of arcade classics or traditional games, including Breakout, Centipede, a sliding puzzle, Amidar or Solitaire. Most games rely on quick reflexes or luck.

games.name: Discs of Daedalus
games.overview:
Years of experimentation paid off for the research team made up of earth's greatest biophysicists. After repeated failures, they perfected a bio-interfaceable anti-gravity compound— a synthetic metal which, when brought into contact with living cells such as in a human hand, would float like a helium balloon. 

But the team's triumph was short-lived. For warmongering Jershans, who monitored the broadcast of the scientists' press conference, kidnapped the entire team and enslaved them to work in laboratories on various planets throughout the Jershan space system, planning to exploit their genius for the purpose of weapon design. An early warning system protecting all the planets prevents any spacecraft from landing and staging a rescue attempt. The Jershans did not count on earth's elite rescue corps using the scientists' own invention to save them. For by dropping pieces of the anti-gravity substance to the planet's surface from a safe distance above, the scientists could be enabled to float to the rescue ships -and freedom. 
The fragments to be used, cast by the scientists in the shape of weightlifting plates, have been code named the Discs of Daedalus, after the character in Greek myth who escaped imprisonment on wings of his own invention. Published in Ahoy! 1986/11 (Issue #35).

games.name: Discs of Tron
games.overview: Published in CPU (Computer Programmiert zur Unterhaltung) 1984/06. You play as the yellow Tron Player and compete against the opponent by the name of Zark. Your player is on the front disk and your opponent is on the back disk. Hit Zark with the disk and knock him off to win, Zark will be trying to push you off as well, so keep alert and moving around.

games.name: Disintegrator
games.overview:
Disintegrator is an all machine language arcade game. The object is to protect your base from the invading enemy. For your defense, you have at your disposal eight underground silos from which you can launch bombs that will disintegrate the oncoming enemy. These bombs are activated by pressing the appropriate number key (1-8). 

The enemy comes in waves of 15. Once all 15 ships have been successfully shot down, the level is complete and the next wave begins to attack at an increased rate of speed. There are nine levels in all. Pressing the space bar will pause the game. Pressing the space bar a second time will restart the game. If the enemy successfully reaches your base, one of your "lives" is lost. After three hits, your base is destroyed. 

Published in Ahoy! 1985/08 (Issue #20).

games.name: Distance Demon
games.overview: In this horizontal scrolling driving game viewed from the side at an elevated angle with the screen scrolling constantly from left to right, you must drive and overtake other cars. The aim is to drive for as many laps as possible while trying to get the biggest score that you can. You start driving at 60 and once you go above 100 then your score increases and the faster you go the quicker your score increases. You can move up or down, and left or right, and if you hit another car or the sides of the track then you lose one of three lives and have to start again.

games.name: Distichon
games.overview:
Distichon is a one or two player calculation\logic game. The task is to divide a pile of tiles into two unequal piles. Piles with 1 or 2 stones are therefore eliminated. Whoever makes the last move wins. The 1st pile consists of eleven game pieces. The dividing arrow is moved up and down with the cursor keys.

The game is all in German, and was released as part of the 4k BASIC Compo 2009.

games.name: Ditris
games.overview:
Ditris is a straight Tetris variant without gameplay additions besides a split-screen multiplayer mode. Differently shaped blocks fall from the top of the screen and can be turned and moved left and right on the way to the bottom. The goal is to create full horizontal lines which vaporize after completion: more lines at once reward more points for the high score. The next block is shown in a preview screen and the game is over when a block can't fall far enough to leave the top of the screen.

Published in Italy under the name Put in both Special Program n.79 (settembre 1991) and Hit Parade C64 n.62 (Dicembre 1991).

games.name: Dive
games.overview: Dive has the player in control of a team of divers with the goal to recover treasures from the bottom of the ocean. The player controls a single diver at a time and must get to the bottom to collect treasure as quickly as possible since each minute underwater uses up precious air. Hungry sharks patrol the waters and must be avoided at all cost. Different difficulty levels determine the amount of air available to the player. The crew size is the number of lives (quite literally) that the player has. From the book "Commodore 64 - Fun and Games".

games.name: Dive Bomber (U.S. Gold)
games.overview: In World War 2, the Bismarck battleship has been dominant thus far. Armed with torpedoes and a machine gun, can you destroy the Bismarck with a well-aimed torpedo and turn the tide of WW2 in the Allies' favour? Find out is this flight simulation and strategy game. How you complete the task is largely up to you. You will need to deal with the plane's instruments, to take off, and plan which areas of the sky you patrol in the search for the Bismarck. There are four distinct instrument panels to control engineer, navigator and gunner functions as well as the main flight controls. Statistics on how much of each enemy's fleet you destroy are kept.

games.name: Dizzy Collection
games.overview:
Compilation compiling the first five games in the Dizzy series:

    Dizzy (replaced by Kwik Snax on 16-bit platforms)
    Fast Food
    Treasure Island Dizzy
    Fantasy World Dizzy
    Magicland Dizzy

Fast Food is a Pac-Man style game.

games.name: Dizzy Dice
games.overview: Dizzy Dice is a gambling game simulating a fruit machine. You start with a fixed amount of cash. As you play and get winning combinations, you'll have to choose whether to collect or gamble what you've won. After completing the fruit machine game, you'll get the chance to play a dice game where you have to guess if the next throw will be higher or lower than the current one. Dizzy Dice features two game modes. The first one you play as a normal fruit machine. But then there also is the bank mode, where you start with $20 and need to reach $100 to break the first bank. In total there is five banks, each requiring more cash to win. The game is controlled using the keyboard.

games.name: DJ Puff
games.overview: The player is DJ Puff the fire breathing dragon, set out to fry all your enemies in one puff. The objective of the game is to collect certain 'discs' spread across the game. These discs are either placed in hard to reach places or appear after you defeat certain types of monsters. Basically you have to blast your way through or fly (jump) through treacherous terrain: water and bamboo sticks are one of many terrain types that can kill your character. Blasted monsters turn into 'bonus fruit' (yes, fruit) of which you can obtain for additional points. A unique attribute of DJ Puff is that you can modify the speed to a very wide range, therefore the current CPU speed can be modified to suit the player (from Zzzzz speed to Lightning speed).

versions.label: DJ Puff's Volcantic Capers (1992)(Codemasters)[cr NEI TAL][t NEI TAL]

games.name: Django
games.overview: What do you think of being transported in a time machine, to the old West, where the only way to survive is to shoot before others shoot you? The aim of the game is just that: to survive the attack of armed gangsters who try to kill you. For each criminal killed you get a reward, but be careful to not hit the poor defenseless people walking n the streets. If you do, you will be penalized and required to pay a reward to the loved ones of the deceased. Fortunately at the end of your labors you can go to the saloon and participate in a good game of Blackjack. Published in Game On 1990/10 and as Abilene in New Special PlayGames n.38 (gennaio 1991).

games.name: DNA Warrior
games.overview: Professor R. Szymanski has injected an accelerator and DNA into your brain to make you more intelligent. Just as the DNA was at the required level there was an explosion in the lab which sent the Professor into a coma. He was the only one who knew how to stop the experiment so a navy assault ship is shrunk and injected into your blood stream to go and stop the DNA from growing. Eight pieces of a growth inhibitor must be collected before facing your brain. With a foreign body in your blood, blood cells and other parts of your body are trying to destroy you. You must battle these to hopefully get to the brain and stop your brain from exploding. Another hindrance is the fact that you have to find all the inter-cellular junctions to move about the body. Some require keys. Plasma spheres can be found along the way to upgrade your ship and weapons. DNA warrior is a horizontally side-scrolling shoot-em-up. The joystick will steer your ship while the fire button will fire your weapon. Pressing the space bar will select your next upgrade when a plasma sphere is collected. Also seen on the screen is a energy gauge, score and a ship upgrade to select.

games.name: Dneiper River Line
games.overview: The Dnieper River Line is a fictionalized engagement between German and Russian forces in the Southern Ukraine in late 1943. As the Germans you are challenged to repel Russian efforts to breach your critical defensive position. The Soviet units controlled by the computer seek to over run your thin German defensive line and capture sufficient objectives to assure victory. Dnieper River Line is a computer game which is played out board game style with a 8" x 11" mapboard and 240 5/8" illustrated counters.

games.name: Do or Die
games.overview:
A strategy game published in Magic Disk 64 1994/02. You are in the Empire of Tiror, which has existed for millennia, but the birth rate has been falling steadily for the past 500 years. This caused serious problems, since there were simply too few Tironians to control the colonial system, but these are absolutely necessary to maintain the standard of living. Fortunately, however, Dr.
Smirtok at the last minute developed the so-called ROBCOM system. This is an intelligent computer system, which was then installed throughout the empire and has since taken over all tasks. This enabled the Tironians to live a life in peace and without work in the main Tiror system. But suddenly contact with the colonial systems broke off. The Robot war fleet was dispatched immediately, but it also disappeared. So a small manned squadron was sent under Captain Preiner, but shortly afterwards Preiner sent SOS from the Starxis colonial system.
So King Xerix IV had no choice but to ask the SPACEWARRIORS caste for help. This emerged from the original war fleet before ROBCOM took over the war trade. Since then, the members of this caste have lived a life as hermits in their legendary SPACEFIGHTER spaceships. But their code of honor tells them to comply with the king's request, and so the last 4 space warriors Kriz, Geriex, Samier and Rex start to save the empire.

Game screen layout:
Top left: Here is a section of the playing area and in the middle a symbol that represents your squadron.
Top-middle: Here you will find a small screen for various graphics.
Top right: This is the communication window for texts and the system card.
Middle: Logo of the manufacturer Middle left: Here is a line of text that shows you the current location coordinates in the system and the designation for the field on which you are currently located.
Below: There you can see the skills of your team.

versions.label: Do or Die (1994)(CP Verlag)[cr DTC][t +26 DTC]

games.name: Doc Croc's Outrageous Adventures!: Round the Bend!
games.overview: Kids TV show Round the Bend was set in a fictitious comic factory - one with amazingly even more toilet humor than the real things. In this licensed game Doc Croc has blown up the printing press, and Lou Brush must go through the sewers to retrieve all 8 pages. After selecting a section from the initial screen of pipes, gameplay involves moving through scrolling platform sections in order to reach the sheets. Once this is done each page is played out as a single-screen multi-layered screen. The specific settings are influenced by the TV show, including Doc Croc’s Nursery Crimes, The False Teeth Versus the Atomic Banana, and Kenny McTickle and His Magic Kilt.

versions.label: Round the Bend! (1991)(Zeppelin Games)[cr EMP][t +1 EMP]
Round the Bend! (1991)(Zeppelin Games)[cr Hysteric][t Hysteric]
Round the Bend! (1991)(Zeppelin Games)[cr SCS][t +1 SCS]

games.name: Doc the Destroyer
games.overview: Centuries of pollution have destroyed the environment, causing the few survivors to live beneath the energy dome - outside of this havoc and dark creatures reign. Against all advice, Doc the Destroyer attempts to put things right by convincing people to return overground. Gameplay has several distinct elements, beginning with creating a character by balancing strength, endurance, luck, charisma and intelligence. Each area you travel through is described in text, and you will be presented with options as to where to explore, hide, flee, fight etc. Fights involve the gameplay moving into one-on-one beat 'em up territory, which has several moves on the C64 version but is more timing-related on the Spectrum implementation.
